notes: Day 25 concludes with the consecration of the church of St. Julius (ቅዱስ ዮልዮስ) of Akfahs: ¶፴፭ completes from page 103 ('ወቀደሳ አባ እለእስክን' joined with 'ድሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ምስለ ኤጲስቆጶሳቲሁ...'), followed by doxology ¶፴፮ ('ወስብሐት ለእግዚአብሔር...'). Arke hymn for St. Julius ('ሰላም ለቅዳሴ ቤትከ...'). Day 26 (ጥቅምት ፳ወ፮) opens with commemoration of the Apostle St. Timon (ቅዱስ ጢሞና ሐዋርያ) of the 72 disciples and 7 deacons (¶፩-፭). ¶፭ cuts at bottom of page ('ወሶበ ሰምዐ ዘንተ መኰንነ ይእቲ ሀገር' / 'የዚያች አገር ገዢም ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ') and completes on page 105 ('አኀዞ ለቅዱስ ጢሞና...'). Ethiopic punctuation and numerals fully verified against page_104.png. [2026-11-04 re-check vs scan: fixed 13 misreadings incl. reordered Amharic ¶1, invented ኵሎ/ጰንጠቆስጤ.]
